title: Crate to forest: a tiger's release

scenes.headline: A 3-year-old Amur tiger gets a second chance
scenes.body: Flagged as a 'conflict tiger', he was captured, collared and released instead of kept in captivity.

scenes.headline: The collar lets researchers follow where he goes

caption:
The only glow-up that matters: crate to forest.

Tigers are listed as Endangered on the IUCN Red List, so every individual returned to the wild counts.

Source: WWF Tigers (Wikimedia Commons file description); IUCN Red List. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Before/after with a true pairing: both wipe halves are the same tiger from the same WWF clip, seconds apart. Conservation story instead of a cosmetic glow-up.
